payload.reason: The evidence provides specific details about features extracted from text, particularly in the context of Named Entity Recognition (NER) and text analytics.

claims.text: Features extracted from text include keywords representing names and surnames, which are used to classify named entities.
Text features are extracted using techniques like Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) and bag-of-words for clustering and classification.
NER systems utilize local features such as part-of-speech tags and previous/next words, although these are limited in noisy data contexts.
